messages:
nina_mkt: Quick note  interviewed HelioCore today. They offered a concise line for the case: "Redwood made our inference costs predictable and substantially lower in production." Need legal + comms sign-off and webinar routing.

omar_growth: Nice. Paste verbatim and attach clip. I'll prep a 10s social teaser after approval.

nina_mkt: Verbatim: "Redwood made our inference costs predictable and substantially lower in production." Audio uploaded to Files.

zyra_legal: Recommend soften to avoid comparative/absolute terms: "significantly reduced per-inference costs while improving predictability". Confirm with HelioCore comms and attach signed release.

leo_cs: They signed the standard advocacy release. I pinged their comms for the softened wording and exact attribution (name + title). No embargo requested.

track-bot: Publish checklist: release attached, comms approval, SFDC campaign created, CDN assets uploaded.

omar_growth: Routing notes: will create SFDC campaign 'HelioCore_Case_24' and route high-intent registrants to AE queue. Please include use_case and company_size fields on the form.

nina_mkt: Comms approved the edited quote and provided attribution: "Rita Alvarez, CTO, HelioCore". Release attached to CMS. Landing draft updated.

zyra_legal: Legal sign-off complete. Use attribution exactly as provided.

omar_growth: Campaign created (ID SF-9412), form live at https://info.redwood.ai/heliocore-case. Scheduling promos for Monday 9am PT. Nina, pls confirm CTA and I'll launch.

nina_mkt: CTA set to 'Read the case + register'. Confirmed  launching Monday. Thanks team :rocket:
